info.name: PHED — Payroll Approval Workflow & Access Matrix (Module 12 & 13)
info.description:
Complete API reference for the Payroll Approval Workflow (Module 12) and Role-Based Payroll Access Matrix (Module 13). Companion to the existing `PHED_Postman_Collection.json` — this collection covers only the two new modules; everything else in PHED is unchanged.

## Quick start
1. Run every request in **Auth — Login as PHED Role** once (Collection Runner works well) — each saves its JWT into a dedicated variable automatically.
2. Set `periodId` to a PhedPayPeriod id that is already `APPROVED` in the payroll engine lifecycle (precondition for Stage 1 submit).
3. Run **Module 12** folder top-to-bottom to walk the full 5-stage chain — `memoId` is captured automatically.
4. Use **Module 13** folder to exercise the access matrix; swap the Authorization token between role variables to see both the 200 and 403 sides of each rule.

## The 403 vs 409 distinction (read this before testing Module 12)
- **403** = your role is not allowed to call this endpoint *at all* (e.g. Tax Team calling `/recommend`).
- **409** = your role is valid for this action, but the memo is not at your desk right now, or is already fully approved (e.g. the CFO trying to approve while the memo still sits with Head IAD).

## New roles
These 8 PHED roles are independent of the existing global `role` field (HR/ADMIN/STAFF/MANAGER/SUPER_ADMIN) and have no effect on any other module. They exist only via the seeded accounts in the Auth folder — there is currently no endpoint to assign a PHED role to an arbitrary staff member.

## Login response — role fields
For these 8 accounts, `POST /api/auth/login` (and `GET /api/auth/me`) now returns the PHED role name directly in `user.role` (e.g. `MANAGER_COMP_BENEFITS`), not `STAFF`. A companion field `user.phedAccessRole` carries the same value. Non-PHED users continue to see their global role in `user.role` and `null` for `user.phedAccessRole`. The JWT token itself still carries the global role — only the response body fields change.

item.description:
These 8 accounts are seeded by `scripts/seed-phed-approval-roles.ts` and exist only in dev/test tenants that have run it. Each login auto-saves its JWT into a dedicated collection variable (e.g. `token_iad`) via the request's Tests script, so the rest of the collection can reference `{{token_iad}}` etc. directly without manual copy/paste. Passwords shown are the seed script's default temp passwords — if you've changed them, update the request body before running.

Run all 8 once at the start of a session (Collection Runner works well here) before touching the Module 12/13 folders below.

item.name: Module 12 — Payroll Approval Workflow

request.description:
**Role:** `MANAGER_COMP_BENEFITS` only.

**Precondition:** the target PhedPayPeriod must be in `REVIEW` status (payroll has been computed — no further HR approval of the period is needed before submitting). `comment` is optional.

If a memo for this period already exists and is `RETURNED_FOR_CORRECTION` (i.e. was flagged), this call **reuses that same memo record** instead of creating a new one. Saves `memoId` automatically on success.

request.description:
**Roles:** same as Get Memo Detail. Returns a **binary PDF**, not JSON — in Postman, use 'Send and Download' to save it.

PDF sections in order:
1. Header (company name, status, current stage)
2. MEMO/DATE/TO/FROM/SUBJECT box
3. Approval sentence
4. Section A — Total Payroll Cost (3-column table: Gross / Deductions / Net Pay by staff category)
5. Salary Earnings Breakdown — non-zero earnings components aggregated across all staff (Basic Salary, each allowance, Overtime), ending with Total Gross Pay totals row
6. Section B — Deductions and Remittances
7. Section C — Total Net Pay (bold highlight bar)
8. Approval Stamp Ledger — current attempt only (superseded stamps from prior flagged attempts are not printed)

response.name: 200 OK — binary PDF (headers shown, body omitted)
response.body: <binary PDF data>

request.description: **Roles:** the 5 approval-chain roles only — Treasury/Tax/Financial Reporting hold no desk and get 403. Powers Screen 1. Three possible shapes for `data`: memo at your desk, memo elsewhere (situational awareness even when it's not your turn), or nothing active at all.

403 — role has no desk (e.g. Tax Team)

item.description:
Run in order: Stage 1 (as Manager) → Stage 2 Recommend (as Head IAD) → Stage 3 Approve (as CPO) → Stage 4 Approve (as CFO) → Stage 5 Final Approve (as MD/CEO). `memoId` is captured automatically by Stage 1's Tests script. Run the 8 logins in the Auth folder first.

Try 'Flag Back' after Stage 2 instead of continuing forward to see the full flag → resubmit cycle: flag it, then re-run 'Stage 1 — Submit for Approval' (it reuses the same memoId), then continue forward again.

item.name: Module 13 — Role-Based Payroll Access Matrix

request.description:
**Allowed PHED roles:** TREASURY_TEAM, plus all 4 full-access roles (MANAGER_COMP_BENEFITS, CHIEF_PEOPLE_OFFICER, CHIEF_FINANCE_OFFICER, MD_CEO), plus global HR/ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN.

**Extra rule, Treasury only:** the period's Approval Memo must already be `APPROVED` (Module 12 Stage 5 outcome). Full-access roles and HR/Admin bypass this — they may need to review it before approving.

request.description: **Roles:** global HR/ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN only — this is a write action, not page-matrix gated. `reason` must be one of: RESIGNATION, TERMINATION, RETIREMENT, END_OF_CONTRACT, OTHER. Also deactivates the staff member (`isActive: false`) in the same transaction — you don't need to call the plain `DELETE /api/phed/staff/:id` separately for a formal exit.

item.description: All `GET .../reports/*` requests here need `periodId` set to a real PhedPayPeriod with computed payroll. Switch the Authorization token between role variables (`token_treasury`, `token_tax`, `token_finrep`, `token_iad`, `token_mdceo`, ...) to see the matrix enforced in both directions — every request below already targets the role it's *supposed* to work for; change the token to one that shouldn't have access to reproduce the 403 examples saved on each request.
